map_visual_style.name: Map visual style
map_visual_style.description: The same styles on every graphics renderer. Balanced keeps the original palette; Vivid strengthens country colours; Relief emphasises mountain shading. Changes immediately, without reducing detail or changing gameplay.

map_consistent_lighting.name: Consistent atlas lighting
map_consistent_lighting.description: Avoid overbright shadow blending on the map in Compatibility. Mountain relief, cloud shadows and shadows on 3D objects remain. Disable to restore scenery shadows projected onto the map surface; Forward+ keeps its original lighting either way.

map_cloud_opacity.name: Cloud veil strength
map_cloud_opacity.description: Keep the moving sky but make it more transparent for a clearer political map. Only decorative clouds and their shadows change; fog of war and intelligence do not.
